{{Quote|A long time ago, the Wookiees came from another planet to Kashyyyk.|Attichitcuk|<ref name="storybook" />}}
According to a legend,<ref name="Gamer">{{GamerCite|4|Secrets of Kashyyyk}}</ref> a long [[time]] before<ref name="storybook" /> [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="date">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' establishes that [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]]. As ''[[The Wookiee Storybook]]'' takes place on Chewbacca's two-hundredth [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]], it must take place in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> a '''planet''' served as the [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. However, they left the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in favor of the world of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]],<ref name="storybook" /> located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]]</ref>

Wookiee records rarely mentioned the planet, and when they did, they only gave vague information, which included a suggestion that the Wookiees who came to Kashyyyk were pioneers or [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]].<ref name="Gamer" /> In 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="date" /> the Wookiee [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] told the story of the Wookiees' old planet to his grandson, [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]].<ref name="storybook" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet was first mentioned in ''[[The Wookiee Storybook]]'', a [[1978]] young readers book written by [[Eleanor Ehrhardt]].<ref name="storybook" />
